en.headline: Salt-water pipe leak near Chi Lin Nunnery disrupts flush supply
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department is repairing a 300 mm salt-water main on Fung Tak Road after a leak reported in the early hours, affecting flush water to the Hammer Hill Road area.
body: The Water Supplies Department said it received a report in the early hours of Thursday of a pipe leak on Fung Tak Road near Chi Lin Nunnery in Diamond Hill.

Engineers confirmed the affected main is a 300-millimetre salt-water supply pipe that serves flush water to the Hammer Hill Road near King Tung Street area. Repair teams are on site and aim to restore supply as soon as possible.
The department apologised for the inconvenience caused to residents and said it would complete the works and resume normal flush-water service at the earliest opportunity.

zh.headline: 鑽石山鳳德道鹹水管滲漏 沖廁水受影響
zh.dek: 水務署凌晨接報鑽石山鳳德道近志蓮淨苑有水管滲漏，確認為300毫米鹹水管，正維修並盡快恢復斧山道近瓊東街一帶沖廁水供應。
body: 水務署表示，今日凌晨接獲報告指鑽石山鳳德道近志蓮淨苑有水管滲漏，經了解後確認涉事為一條直徑300毫米的鹹水供水管。
該管負責供應沖廁水予斧山道近瓊東街一帶。署方工程團隊正進行維修，會盡快完成工程及恢復供應。
水務署就事件為市民帶來不便致歉，並承諾盡快恢復正常沖廁水服務。
